steps.en: Install the controller and server into your Kubernetes cluster
steps.zh: 把控制器和服务端装进你的 Kubernetes 集群

steps.en: Write a Workflow in YAML: each template is a container, ordered as steps or a DAG
steps.zh: 用 YAML 写 Workflow：每步一个容器，排成 steps 或 DAG

steps.en: Creates one pod per step in order, passing parameters and artifacts between them
steps.zh: 按顺序为每一步创建一个 pod，在步骤间传递参数和产物

steps.en: Retries failed steps and writes each node's status back into the Workflow
steps.zh: 重试失败的步骤，把每个节点的状态写回 Workflow

steps.en: Shows the run as a graph with per-step logs in the UI and CLI
steps.zh: 在界面和 CLI 里把整次运行显示成图，附每步日志

value.en: Container pipelines get ordering, retries and a visible run history without a separate scheduler or worker fleet
value.zh: 容器流水线有了顺序、重试和可见的运行记录，不用另建调度器或 worker 集群
